How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Using the Kinn Cleaning Pen is very simple! First, twist the bottom of the pen to dispense a small amount of the cleaning formula onto the soft brush tip.
Gently brush the formula over your solid gold, sterling silver, or platinum jewelry, using the bristles to reach into crevices, behind stone settings, and around hard-to-access areas.
Rinse your piece with warm water and dry it with a soft cloth to reveal its original shine.
